must_fix.issue: Closing pitch line in 'From the ring to the wedding abroad' reads as brochure copy with no backing: 'anywhere in the world' and 'from first idea to the last dance' lost trust or drew objections, and 'payments' with no accountability line raised money questions.
must_fix.fix: Replace the sentence after the Wedded Concierge link with brand-facts claims only, e.g. 'A Wedded Advisor plans venue, travel, vendors and payments as your one point of contact, and the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins.' Drop 'anywhere in the world' and 'first idea to the last dance'. Do not add anything on deposits, commission, scale or named contacts (deferred business answers).

should_fix.issue: The search answer (the list of styles) sits in the FAQ at the bottom, and the carry-on/insurance takeaway answers a question a styles searcher did not ask.
should_fix.fix: Swap the carry-on/insurance takeaway for a style takeaway that names all 15 styles in one sentence (use the FAQ list wording: solitaire, halo, hidden halo, three-stone, toi et moi, east-west, cluster, vintage-inspired, art deco, pavé, bezel style, split shank, eternity-style, bypass and coloured gemstone centres). Keep exactly 4 takeaways, one sentence each. Keep the insurance advice in the 'Check your insurance covers overseas travel' H3 and keep its fact_49 marker there.

should_fix.issue: The 'Quick comparison: all 15 engagement ring styles at a glance' table is the most-used element but appears after all 15 style sections.
should_fix.fix: Move the table (H2 and rows unchanged, apart from the east-west 'Suits' cell if C1 is applied) to directly after Key takeaways, before 'How to use this guide'.

consider.issue: 'Understated contrarian' (east-west, Suits you if) reads as too clever.
consider.fix: Use plain words, e.g. 'the wearer likes a classic shape with a twist'. Optionally change the table cell 'Quiet contrarians' to match (e.g. 'Classic with a twist').

consider.issue: Jeweller-check interval is inconsistent: takeaways say 'every six months, or at least yearly', How to choose says 'every six months'.
consider.fix: Align How to choose to 'with a jeweller check every six months, or at least yearly', matching fact_47 in 03-source-pack.json.

consider.issue: 'GIA says' repeats through the style sections so the brand's own view is hard to hear (primary persona's top change).
consider.fix: In two or three style sections, drop the 'GIA says/notes' lead-in and state the advice in Wedded Wonderland's own planning voice, keeping the fact_ markers and the GIA attribution in the first mention and in the Style versus setting section. Add no new facts and no experience or volume claims (those are [[VERIFY]] per brand-facts).

consider.issue: Fifteen 'On the trip' lines make a long mobile page feel like a destination-wedding piece, and three of them repeat 'check before you fly'.
consider.fix: Lighten, do not remove: keep the distinct lines (solitaire low profile, hidden halo photographer brief, three-stone close-up, vintage packing, art deco light, bezel, eternity underside, coloured stone swap). Shorten the repeated halo, cluster and pavé 'check before you fly' lines to a few words each or point back to the takeaway. Keep fact_ markers on any line kept.

consider.issue: No visible 'last updated' date for a style guide.
consider.fix: Add a last_updated front-matter field with the publish-ready date so the CMS step can show it; no body copy change needed.

deferred_not_must_fix: Deposits, supplier contracts and who holds payments (funding_parent, sceptic): brand-facts 'Deposits, refunds, contracts' is deferred; do not write it. Partly answered by the brand-facts line that the fee is agreed in writing before any work begins (must_fix fix).
Fee model, commission or mark-up (sceptic): deferred in brand-facts.
Named Advisor, phone line, a call before anything is booked (funding_parent): deferred.
Real wedding with venue, date or budget (planner_couple, sceptic): deferred.
Private-client or referral channel, 200 to 400 guests, exclusive use, security, NDAs (uhnw): deferred; no scale claims.
Relative cost by style (search_visitor): no prices; the existing spend-guide link covers it.
keep: The 'suits you if' / 'think twice if' format for every style (sceptic, search_visitor, planner_couple).
Intro line promising a shortlist of two or three styles before seeing a jeweller (planner_couple, sceptic, funding_parent).
Named GIA sourcing with the catch stated, e.g. the pavé underside advice and the style versus setting definition (sceptic, funding_parent, search_visitor).
Hidden halo 'On the trip' line about briefing the photographer for the side-profile shot (planner_couple).
Napoleon and Josephine toi et moi detail (uhnw).
FAQ straight answers, especially 'Neither. A solitaire is clean...' (sceptic).
The quick comparison table (search_visitor, planner_couple, sceptic): move it, do not cut it.
The 'Check your insurance covers overseas travel' H3 (planner_couple, funding_parent).
Closing line 'in your time zone and, for Australian couples, quoting in AUD' (funding_parent, planner_couple, sceptic).
The how-much-to-spend internal link (search_visitor) and the destinations hub link (brief goal).
Calm, no-gush tone throughout (planner_couple, uhnw, sceptic).
conflicts_resolved: Carry-on/insurance advice: funding_parent and planner_couple valued it; search_visitor and uhnw found it off-topic as a key takeaway. Resolved by moving it out of the takeaways only; the full advice stays in the insurance H3, which is what the primary persona (planner_couple) praised.

GIA citations: sceptic and funding_parent trust them; planner_couple (primary) wants more of the brand's own voice. Resolved by keeping GIA attribution and all fact markers, and rewording only two or three repeated lead-ins in the brand's voice with no new facts.

'On the trip' lines: search_visitor wants fewer; planner_couple (primary) wants more of the wedding-trip angle. The brief's reader includes 'the flight to and the week of a wedding abroad', so the lines stay; only the repeated 'check before you fly' lines are shortened.
'Quoting in AUD': uhnw dislikes leading with currency; funding_parent, planner_couple and sceptic praised it. Kept for the primary persona and the brand-facts claim.

Low enquiry likelihood (1.70): this is a top-of-funnel ring guide whose brief goal is a destinations hub click, with the Concierge enquiry secondary. Every persona except uhnw read on and would share it. The gap is mostly deferred business answers, so the fix is cleaner, factual brand lines, not more sales copy.
